Maria G: quick q — we have a live latency spike on a customer shard. I need to SSH into one of the app nodes to check logs/threads. What are the approved, safe prod shell steps? Can I scp logs out for local grep?
Sam T: short answer: follow the runbook JIT + session-recording flow. don't copy raw logs off-box unless you push to the approved artifact bucket. sampling + redaction in-place is preferred.
Priya S: +1. Steps I use: 1) open incident ticket in #incidents, 2) request JIT access via Okta (attach ticket id), 3) use bastion (session recorded), 4) run read-only checks or pipe through redact tool.
Alex P: runbook has a tiny checklist under "oncall safe probes" — common commands (read-only) you can run:
```
# tail the last 500 lines, mask locally, only copy snippet
tail -n 500 /var/log/redwood/app.log | ./scripts/redact.sh | head -n 200
# get thread stacks without dumping full heap
ps aux | rg myservice | awk '{print $2}' | xargs -n1 gstack || gcore (avoid unless approved)
```
Dylan R: to be explicit about scp: do NOT scp full log files to your laptop. If you need a full file, upload to s3://redwood-incident-artifacts (server-side KMS) and mark retention. adhoc scp to personal devices is a no.
Maria G: where is redact.sh? I grabbed a copy but want to be sure it's the canonical one.
Sam T: canonical is in infra/tools/redact.sh in the repo. It masks emails, IPs, SSNs, auth headers. Use it with `--pattern` if you expect extra PII. Do not edit the script on prod.
Priya S: also remember ephemeral sudo. When you request JIT, you get ephemeral sudo group membership for ~20m. Include purpose and ticket id. If you need longer, get approver in security.
SecBot: JIT_ACCESS: token created for Maria G (expires 20m). Approval required from oncall lead.
oncall-bot: session recording started: https://replay.internal/redwood/session/abcd1234 (auto-attaches to incident ticket #INC-5421)
Dylan R: if you find PII in logs, stop and escalate to Security & Legal. Dont keep local copies. If you must share snippets in Slack, scrub with redact.sh and add a note about what was removed.
Alex P: tiny tip — use `rg --max-columns 200` or `sed -n '1,200p'` to avoid dumping huge lines into the terminal buffer, which can leak into session recordings.
Maria G: thanks everyone — I'll follow JIT + bastion, run the redact pipeline, push relevant sanitized snippets to the incident artifact bucket and paste sanitized excerpt here. pinging @Sam T for approver when needed :slightly_smiling_face:
